files.note: Generic-ised: domain boundaries (marketing/audit lanes), quality-log protocol and MCP-specific tool names removed; freshness rule added. removed a promise no skill keeps (per-skill model) and the quick/code lane self-contradiction.
Physically shipped by kit3. kit1_reliability references this entry instead of carrying a second copy.
Written from scratch. Anthropic's deep-research skill is referenced, never copied.

Generic-ised: hardcoded vault path replaced with {{VAULT_PATH}}, owner field dropped, Exa/Filesystem MCP names replaced with capability descriptions, source_tier field added. project-relative paths (plugin channel never renders placeholders); naming pattern covers paper and video.

Converted agent to skill; three modes preserved. Model declaration dropped — the source declares opus unconditionally, which contradicts the model-routing rule. See build report, backport item B1. template now carries the TL;DR and Sources sections report_format mandates.
New. Blueprint §4 lists it under research rules; no single source file existed. recency-vs-authority conflict with citation_checker resolved explicitly.
TL;DR-first and progressive-disclosure principles kept; personal accessibility context and client-specific display guidance removed.

Self-contained light-theme HTML report shell that report_builder copies. Obeys the skill's Output-as-HTML rules literally: no external assets, no JS, no build step, <details> for the detail layer. A VIEW of the markdown, never the source of truth. render:false so the [[...]] author markers survive install (they are examples, not placeholders).
Six-tier vault reduced to three tiers relevant to research work.

Re-targeted from an internal catalog index to plain markdown notes. Hardcoded library root removed. NumPy made optional with a pure-Python fallback. See build report, backport item B2. Empty-result error now separates "wrong cwd" from "fresh install, no notes yet" - the old text blamed the paths in both cases.
Hardcoded absolute fallback path removed; tier/repo filters replaced with a path filter; dimension mismatch now fails loudly instead of returning nonsense. error text reprinted the broken command.
runnable command, honest network claim, unmeasured thresholds labelled.
Russian translation of FAQ.md. Prose translated; code, paths and file names kept identical to the English so the two locales cannot drift on anything runnable.
